verse.verse_2: who amasses wealth and counts it over and again.
verse.verse_3: He thinks that his wealth will immortalise him forever.
verse.verse_4: Nay, he shall be thrown into the Crusher.
verse.verse_5: And what do you know what the Crusher is?
verse.verse_6: It is the Fire kindled by Allah,
verse.verse_7: the Fire that shall rise to the hearts (of criminals).
verse.verse_8: Verily it will close in upon them,
